sources.note: No phonology content. The entry is ethnographic (occupation, dress, marriage, life-cycle rituals, burial, religion). Only language remarks: 'They speak a dialect of Malayalam' and 'They speak Malayalam with a peculiar intonation' -- the source of the second-hand 'peculiar intonation' line in ISO 639-3 CR 2006-003. Unlike the neighbouring Kadar entry (which has pronoun/verb/vocabulary notes), the Kalanadi entry has no linguistic section, no wordlist, nothing on stress, accent or tone.
